title: UserProfile
description: The caller's own profile. user_id is an internal UUID; the OIDC subject is never exposed to the browser and email is never a primary key.

display_name.description: Name taken from the identity provider, shown only back to the owner.

consents.description: Current effective consent state, one entry per ConsentType the user has ever acted on.

has_emergency_profile.description: Whether an encrypted emergency profile exists. The profile content itself is never included here.
